title: Thomas
sourceLines: -One of the twelve apostles Mt 10:3; Mr 3:18; Lu 6:15
-Present at the raising of Lazarus Joh 11:16
-Asks Jesus the way to the Father’ s house Joh 14:5
-Absent when Jesus first appeared to the disciples after the resurrection Joh 20:24
-Lives with the other apostles in Jerusalem Ac 1:13,14
